ns2:section.sectionText: Placement in this course requires a recent, adequate score on a U of I placement exam. For dates and details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS. Students not meeting the ALEKS prerequisite will be dropped during the second week of the semester. While Math 115 lectures are pre-recorded, this class will have a synchronous Zoom meeting from 4-4:50pm on Monday, January 25, 2021. A make-up meeting will be available later in the week for those unable to attend. Late adds may attend an orientation meeting on Monday, February 8; please see the class website for more information.
